verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduling is a fair axis for a design SaaS with automation APIs, so the story applies. However, the evidence only documents one-off or on-demand automation: bulk create, autofill of Brand Templates, resizing, exports, and MCP and REST actions. None of it documents a recurring schedule or cron-like trigger for jobs or workflows. A developer could build scheduling externally on the REST APIs, but that is a building block and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
